You noclipped out of reality. Tiled halls and still water stretch forever, the lights hum, and a living darkness is hunting you. Find the glowing EXIT. If the shadow catches you, you wake up somewhere behind — but something is counting.

You always run — stop to catch your breath. Desktop: WASD · Mouse · hold Shift to sneak-walk · hold C to HOLD YOUR BREATH (enemies notice you only up close, but your breath meter slowly drains) · Z crouch (slower, harder to spot) · darkness and a switched-off flashlight make you harder to spot · F flashlight · swim in water, hold Space to dive · Esc release mouse

Mobile: left thumb move · right side look · LIGHT flashlight · hold WALK to sneak · hold HOLD to hold your breath · CROUCH toggles crouching

Works on desktop and mobile (landscape recommended). Sound on, headphones recommended.
